media.description: Synthetic clip generated with ffmpeg lavfi: solid red 5 s, green 7 s, blue 4 s; 320x240, 25 fps, 400 frames, H.264 yuv420p
media.generatorCommand: /usr/bin/ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error -y -f lavfi -i color=c=red:s=320x240:r=25:d=5 -f lavfi -i color=c=green:s=320x240:r=25:d=7 -f lavfi -i color=c=blue:s=320x240:r=25:d=4 -filter_complex [0:v][1:v][2:v]concat=n=3:v=1:a=0[v] -map [v] -c:v libx264 -threads 1 -pix_fmt yuv420p -bitexact -fflags +bitexact three-scenes.mp4

config.command: scenedetect-rs -i three-scenes.mp4 --output out detect-content list-scenes --format json
config.configHashInput: detect-content list-scenes --format json (scenedetect-rs defaults; no detector options)
